hooks.name: Keep the Japanese spec translation in step
hooks.description: After the agent saves an English requirements.md or design.md, asks it to update the Japanese reference translation in docs/ja/ (policy in .kiro/steering/japanese-translations.md). tasks.md is left out so that ticking a task does not fire it.

action.prompt: An English spec file under .kiro/specs/ was just saved. Before you finish this change, update its Japanese reference translation docs/ja/<spec>/<same file name> (create it if missing): translate only the parts that changed, set the header line '原文 SHA-256' to the new hash of the English file, and follow .kiro/steering/japanese-translations.md. Then run `sh scripts/ja-check.sh` and make sure it reports no stale translations. Commit the translation together with the English change. Do not edit the English file for this.
